documents.text: Mahmud I of Great Seljuq Nasir ad-Din Mahmud I was the sultan of the Seljuk Empire from 1092 to 1094. He succeeded Malik Shah I as Sultan, but he did not gain control of the empire built by Malik Shah and Alp Arslan. Turkan Khatun, the last wife of Malik Shah, tried to win the throne for her 4 years old son Mahmud, who was proclaimed sultan in Bagdad. The older son of Malik shah, Barkyaruk was proclaimed too, and the armies of the two pretenders meet in Barudjird, near Hamadan. The forces of Barkyaruk won and took the capital
